title: Long path when truncation changes evaluation
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\alpha$ be a type, let $T$ be a decision tree on $n$ coordinates with outputs in $\alpha$, let $a\in\alpha$ be a fallback value, let $k\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $x\in(\mathbb{F}_2)^n$. If the depth-$k$ truncation of $T$ evaluates differently from $T$ at $x$, then there is a path of $T$ matching $x$ whose length is strictly greater than $k$.
hypotheses_covered: Truncated and original evaluations differ at $x$
